releaseNotes:
🛡️ 1000% Data Preservation & Shadow Vault Architecture (v1.1.0) by Dhiraj:
• 🔒 Dual-Tier Shadow Persistence: Every message is duplicated into an un-wipeable, crash-proof shadow vault across internal and external storage
• ⚡ Instant Auto-Recovery Engine: On launch, MsgVault automatically checks database integrity and restores any missing messages from shadow mirrors
• 🛡️ 1-Tap Data Recovery & Rescue: Dedicated 1-tap tool in 3-dots menu to scan device and rescue messages from previous app installations or backups
• 🛡️ Android Fragile User Data Protection: App data is protected from accidental deletion on update or uninstall
• 📦 Unified Package ID: Seamless in-place updates without duplicate apps
